# [CS055] Denied License Detected (license-denied)

A dependency's license is on the deny list.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | License |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

License files in the module cache or vendor/ are classified into SPDX identifiers and compared with dependencies.allow_licenses and deny_licenses. Copyleft licenses such as AGPL-3.0 can impose obligations on the whole program.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```text
require github.com/acme/agpl-lib v1.2.0 // AGPL-3.0
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```text
require github.com/acme/mit-lib v1.4.0 // MIT
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [license-denied]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    license-denied: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore license-denied -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** license-denied
```
